sql.sql:
SELECT *
FROM students
WHERE cohort = $1

SELECT first_name, last_name, gpa
FROM students
WHERE gpa >= $1
ORDER BY gpa DESC
LIMIT $2

SELECT student_id, email, enrolled_on
FROM students
WHERE enrolled_on BETWEEN $1 AND $2
ORDER BY enrolled_on ASC

SELECT *
FROM submissions
WHERE submitted_at >= $1 AND score IS NULL

SELECT assignment_id, round(avg(score), 1) AS avg_score, count(*) AS n
FROM submissions
GROUP BY assignment_id
HAVING count(*) >= $1
ORDER BY avg_score DESC

SELECT submission_id, student_id, score, status
FROM submissions
WHERE status IN ('late', 'resubmitted') AND score < $1

SELECT students.first_name, students.last_name, courses.title
FROM students
INNER JOIN enrollments ON enrollments.student_id = students.student_id
INNER JOIN courses ON courses.course_id = enrollments.course_id
WHERE courses.code = $1

SELECT students.student_id, students.email
FROM students
LEFT JOIN submissions ON submissions.student_id = students.student_id
WHERE submissions.submission_id IS NULL

SELECT courses.code, assignments.title
FROM courses
FULL OUTER JOIN assignments ON assignments.course_id = courses.course_id
WHERE courses.course_id IS NULL OR assignments.assignment_id IS NULL

SELECT courses.department, count(enrollments.enrollment_id) AS enrolled
FROM courses
LEFT JOIN enrollments ON enrollments.course_id = courses.course_id AND enrollments.status = $1
GROUP BY courses.department
ORDER BY enrolled DESC, courses.department ASC

SELECT *
FROM students
WHERE cohort = $1
SELECT 2 * $1::numeric + 3 = 9 AS result

sql.sql:
SELECT sum(work_logs.hours) AS us_hours
FROM work_logs
WHERE work_logs.work_country = 'US' AND extract(year from work_logs.worked_on) = $1

SELECT extract(year from work_logs.worked_on) AS calendar_year, projects.fiscal_year, sum(work_logs.hours) AS us_hours
FROM work_logs
INNER JOIN projects ON projects.project_id = work_logs.project_id
WHERE work_logs.work_country = $1
GROUP BY extract(year from work_logs.worked_on), projects.fiscal_year
ORDER BY calendar_year ASC, projects.fiscal_year ASC
